rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Chance's Dowsing Method Before Each Session", "body": "Chance described using L shaped rods with copper handles or wooden beads to check ten areas of a client's field, from the feet up to the crown, sweeping left, right, front, and back. He assigned one rod to the front of the body and one to the back, and said the whole scan took about three to five minutes. He called the result a roadmap for the hour. Chance credited Eileen Day McKusick as the pioneer of biofield tuning and said he treated her biofield anatomy as a useful language, though he stayed open to it being an imaginary framework."}, {"title": "When the Body Becomes the Dowsing Tool", "body": "Chance described a festival in Southern California where he left his rods behind and tuned only a person's most bottlenecked energy center. He said he scanned a large fork up and down the body, and that his ears popped every time he found the spot, which he credited partly to qigong. Homie Romie compared this with a dowser he had recently interviewed and said he was coming to understand that after a certain point you are the rod. Chance added that the tools were a language for talking with the body's intelligence."}, {"title": "Chance's Case Against Internet Solfeggio Claims", "body": "Chance described the popular list of benefits attached to the nine solfeggio tones, such as repairing DNA, as claims he considered nonsense and could not trace to a source. He guessed that video channels spread them because looped tone videos took little work to make. Chance said that any coherent sound carried intention, that no tone offered a quick fix, and that he still thought the frequencies were magical. He noted that the Wikipedia page on solfeggio described a medieval hymn, which he considered a different thing."}, {"title": "The Phone Keypad and the Regenerating Trinity", "body": "Chance described the three by three grid of a phone keypad, whose columns gave the groupings 147, 258, and 369, matching the three families of solfeggio tones. He explained that the digits of each group added to 12, 15, and 18, which reduced to 3, 6, and 9. Chance said every third number in the number line reduced to one, and he called this a regenerating trinity. He said he found this explanation nowhere else and offered it as his own view. Homie Romie and Dan reacted by tying it to music theory and the way three notes make a chord."}, {"title": "Mother, Father, Child, and the Word Solfeggio", "body": "Chance described 258 as a mirroring of left and right, and 369 as father, mother, and the divine child, while stressing that these were his own ideas and not gospel. He read the word solfeggio as sol, fe, egg, and io, each carrying symbolism for him. Chance said adding or subtracting any of the numbers returned threes, sixes, and nines, which he thought might mirror the body's regenerative pattern. He then played paired forks, and Dan said the exercise spoke to him about community and resonating together."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: I joined Homie Romie on Rising From the Ashes for an infographic walkthrough of the Solfeggio scale, covering its nine frequencies, the number patterns behind them, and my doubts about popular claims, after a warm up on dowsing and biofield tuning.

That's really what I want.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "So my body has become like a dowsing tool in and of itself, because when I find what I have asked to find, what I'm looking for, my ears pop consistent one hundred percent of the time.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The more I do my own research into things versus just listening to talking heads, the more I realize that most people on most subjects in the truth community are repeating each other's information without really looking into the source.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Everything that we experienced in our body is like a message from our body, our higher self or our soul, trying to help us see ourself more clearly and learn the lesson we need to learn in that moment.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Every third number in the number line reduces to one. Every third number returns to oneness and kicks off the trinity again.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Chance, amongst being a beautiful healer, is a podcaster, researcher, and a decoder of the mysteries.", "author": "Homie Romie", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8ed47029-16b2-4d9d-99ed-29cd7642b34c/HOMIE-ROMIE.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I'm kind of coming to this understanding that the rod is incredibly important, but after a certain point you are the rod.", "author": "Homie Romie", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8ed47029-16b2-4d9d-99ed-29cd7642b34c/HOMIE-ROMIE.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Everything that's being talked about is so important because these are modern tactics to bridge the gap between the ancient ways, like this ancient understanding of the biofield.", "author": "Homie Romie", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8ed47029-16b2-4d9d-99ed-29cd7642b34c/HOMIE-ROMIE.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
